'''Bovo Yagen''' was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who fled the Empire with his wife and four sons. After a period of wandering, the family landed on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a humanoid species. Proving their good intentions to the natives, the family was allowed to settle on the world. Over time, more [[Human/Legends|Humans]] fleeing the Empire arrived, forming a small outpost. By the time Yagen passed away, the planet bore his [[Bovo Yagen (planet)|name]].<ref name="CTD" />
